The math behind the Trump Account projections checks out. The assumptions don't.⁣
⁣
The headline numbers rely on decades of contributions, optimistic stock returns, and future dollars that won't buy nearly as much.⁣
⁣
More in this week's Diving In: newsletter.platypuseconomics.com/p/what-the-w...

posts.text:
Trump Accounts give everyone the same account.⁣
⁣
But families with spare cash, generous employers, and higher tax rates stand to benefit the most.⁣
⁣
The result? The biggest gains may go to those who need them least.⁣
⁣
https://newsletter.platypuseconomics.com/p/what-the-white-house-isnt-telling
